tasks.name: 1 · Elites seat-year precision — 90 cards (5 levels x 3 eras), Mac
tasks.description: ELST1027-D2 (a). One question per card: does the evidence on the card (text + link) show this person in this post in the year asked? yes / no / can't tell. 90 covered seat-years, 6 per level x era cell (governor, vice-governor, minister, body head, mayor x 2012-16, 2017-20, 2021-26). No searching needed: the evidence is on the card; 36 governor/mayor cards show the registry record itself (no source link exists) and a ru.wiki name link. Bar (pre-registered): precision yes/(yes+no) >= 0.95 overall and >= 0.90 per level on the point estimate; can't tell reported separately. Scorer elitesData/validation/prec_seat_score_2026-10-27.R. ~45-60 min.

tasks.name: 1 · Prosecution trace (T2-19) — 40 cards, Mac
tasks.description: WPP2V2-D1 (a). One card = one person-prosecution built by the prosecution layer (events in date order with key method and link confidence). Five questions: same person in all events (Q1), one case not merged or split (Q2), stages and dates right (Q3), status right (Q4), person_uid right (Q5, person_uid cards only). 20 person_uid-keyed and 20 provisional-name cards, 8 per level group. Bar (pre-registered, point estimate decides, Wilson interval always shown): Q1 >= 0.90 overall and >= 0.95 on the 20 person_uid cards; Q2 >= 0.85; Q5 >= 0.95. A miss marks the person_uid prosecution keys unverified. Scorer eventsData/validation/wpp2_trace_score_2026-10-27.R. About 1 hour.

tasks.name: 1 · Archived government pages: does the page show the person in the post? (30 cards, Mac)
tasks.description: ELST1027-D2 (a), recall probe. Each card is one person-post observation extracted by Haiku 5.5 from an archived government structure or leadership page: open the archive link and answer yes / no / unsure whether THIS page shows the person holding THIS post on the date shown. Your answers give (1) extraction precision (share yes of 30, Wilson interval) and (2) the master's recall among the yes cards (sealed automated key, 10 of 30 in the master). Descriptive: no pass/fail threshold is pre-registered (stage README). About 45 minutes.

tasks.name: 2 · Regional structure decrees: is the list of bodies right? (20 cards, Mac)
tasks.description: Each card is a regional decree that lists the region's executive bodies, next to the list a program extracted from it. Read the decree text (or open the official page) and say whether the list is complete and whether anything on it is not a body. A start page on the first card explains it in plain words. Bar (pre-registered in the stage README, point estimate decides): at least 18 of 20 cards complete with at most 1 non-body item. About 45 minutes; a desk task.

tasks.name: 2 · Dismissal register vs officials database: same person? (57 cards, Mac)
tasks.description: Each card pairs one entry of the register of officials dismissed for loss of confidence with one person in our officials database (same full name and region). Say whether they are the same person and, if yes, whether the register's post fits one of the person's database posts. A start page on the first card explains it in plain words. Bar (pre-registered in the stage README, point estimate decides): at least 90% of the same-person answers have a post that fits. About 40 minutes. Personal data, private app only.
